summary: Tested Equipment Catalog API and Occupation Proficiencies. All 16 backend tests pass. Frontend Rules page correctly displays 'Precios de Equipo' section with all 4 categories (armas, armaduras, herramientas, equipo general) and 'Ocupaciones' section shows weapon/armor proficiencies correctly separated.
seed_data_creation: Database pre-seeded with equipment catalog and occupation data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Equipment catalog and occupation proficiencies fully tested. Key findings: 1) GET /api/data/equipment-catalog returns 4 categories: armas (29 items), armaduras (9 items), herramientas (17 items), equipo_general (114 items). 2) GET /api/data/occupations returns 6 occupations with correctly separated competencia_armas and competencia_armaduras fields. 3) Campeón has correct proficiencies: armas=['Armas sencillas', 'Armas marciales'], armaduras=['Armaduras ligeras', 'Armaduras medias', 'Armaduras pesadas', 'Escudos']. 4) Rules page frontend correctly displays all equipment with prices and weights in metric units (kg).
